en: Multi‑view colorized postcard with nine small landscape photographs framed on a dark background. At the top, a title panel reads "Wetzelsdorf bei Graz." Each inner view shows a rural or small‑town area with rolling hills, scattered houses with red roofs, fields, and a church. Small captions under the images include several labeled "Wetzelsdorf," one labeled "Johann u. Paul" with a church on a hill, one labeled "K. k. Garnisons‑Schießstätte" showing open ground near a forest, one labeled "Krottendorf" showing a valley settlement, and one labeled "Schweizerhof" depicting a larger building complex by wooded hills.
